filename: The Overlooked Sub-Grid Air-Sea Flux in Climate Models.pdf
title: The Overlooked Sub-Grid Air-Sea Flux in Climate Models
testbed_rationale: Constructs cloud-accessible (ARCO/Zarr) datasets and offline-filtered target fields diagnosing the unresolved subgrid air-sea heat flux, providing benchmark data suitable for formulating and training ML or physics-based subgrid air-sea flux parameterizations.
pain_points: Lack of direct global high-resolution coupled observations of the air-sea state
Nonlinear bulk formulae mean spatially averaged inputs fail to reproduce averaged heat fluxes (rectification error)
Archived daily average outputs miss sub-daily/diurnal nonlinear coupling effects
Computational expense of 2D spatial filtering on global high-resolution grids
Bulk formula algorithms do not handle sea-ice covered areas without masking
extraction_notes: The paper does not train an ML model directly, but diagnoses and establishes the target subgrid air-sea flux (Q*) that low-resolution models neglect, explicitly motivating future parameterization development under LEAP.
